messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price to 0.04, above our 0.03 per-purchase mandate cap, so its queries are refused by Purser. I've switched the buy policy to Ridgeline (0.02, 0.03 margin, but 12 of last 20 unavailable). If you want Stockline's fresher data (5 s) back, we would need the per-purchase cap raised to at least 0.04; the sale price would also need to clear that cost for a sensible margin. Your call.

I've sent a rebalance to the CFO (P-0001/P-0002). It raises your per-purchase cap to 0.04 and your budget from 10.00 to 14.00, which pays for about 348 Stockline checks. Treasury drops 6.00 to 2.00, Support stays at 4.00, total stays 20.00. I recommend option B, a 0.07 query price, which keeps our 0.03 margin. Stay on Ridgeline until the CFO decides.
